name: Underbelly Scales
summary: Verner Osgood needs black dragon whelp underbelly scales to settle his trade debt with Smith Argus of Goldshire. You gather them from young drakes wandering the crags south of Lakeshire. The scales settle Verner’s account and leave enough raw hide to craft a piece of gear.

sections.title: A Frontier Debt
sections.body: Verner Osgood runs a forge on the outskirts of Lakeshire and often trades with craftsmen beyond the Redridge Mountains. Smith Argus of Goldshire sent him a shipment of horseshoes, but Verner is short on coin. Argus demands valuable dragonhide in payment: the highly prized, softer underbelly scales of the black dragon whelps nesting in the region. Without them, collectors may come from Elwynn Forest to claim the debt.

sections.title: Brood of the Black Flight
sections.body: Black dragon whelps in the Redridge Mountains alarm the local defenders. Gnolls and orcs contest the roads, while the Black Dragonflight nests in the high peaks and its brood wanders the skies south of Lake Everstill. The young predators’ underbelly scales are tough yet pliable. Armorers, smiths, and leatherworkers across the kingdom prize them, if they dare to harvest them.

faq.q: Why does Verner Osgood need dragon scales?
faq.answer: Verner owes Smith Argus of Goldshire for a shipment of horseshoes. Argus demands underbelly scales from black dragon whelps instead of regular coin. Verner needs them delivered quickly, before Argus sends collectors to enforce the debt.

faq.q: Where are the black dragon whelps found in Redridge?
faq.answer: Black dragon whelps commonly roam the rocky crags and valleys south of Lakeshire. They wander across the southern foothills, so hunters often patrol the trails and ridges to spot them in flight.
Smith Argus is the blacksmith stationed at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He provides metalwork and forged goods to nearby settlements, including horseshoes for Verner Osgood in Redridge.

faq.q: Why are black dragon whelps in Redridge Mountains?
aliases: why are there dragons in redridge
faq.answer: The Black Dragonflight keeps a presence throughout the Burning Steppes and the surrounding peaks of Redridge. Its whelps hunt and wander south through the mountain passes into the Redridge foothills.

Underbelly scales are supple and flexible, unlike the thick, rigid scales along a drake’s back. They retain high resistance to heat and punctures, making them useful for specialized leatherworking, tailored reinforcement, and exotic trade goods.

faq.q: Does clearing this debt lead to other tasks for Verner?
faq.answer: This follows Verner Osgood’s request after you bring him his horseshoe shipment. Alongside this optional gathering, Verner sends adventurers to hunt gnoll scouts and leaders as the threat in Redridge grows.

angles.text: Smith Argus’s demand shows how smiths barter rare reagents like dragon scales when standard coin is scarce.
The Black Dragonflight’s growing threat south of Lakeshire adds to the burdens on Redridge’s already overstretched garrison.
As a human, you know trade routes between Elwynn and Redridge supply towns like Lakeshire, though frontier craftsmen often pay steep prices to city merchants.
